items.title: Gaoteng ships 1MW storage system to a Kenya microgrid
items.body: Our 51.2V rack batteries and 10kW hybrid inverters are now powering a rural microgrid serving 400+ households.

items.title: New 600W half-cut panel reaches 21.7% efficiency

items.title: BIS-ready LiFePO4 series for the India market
